thread:
zoe: kicking off maelstrom9b int8 canary. overnight run showed 2 OOMs and odd p95 spikes under b=6, max_new_tokens=1500. sharing quick notes.

raj: saw the alerts. OOMs at ~01:02 and ~01:26 UTC. stack trace points to many tiny allocations in KV prefetch path.

patrick: is this the same fragmentation pattern we've had with int4 elsewhere? int8 should have fewer tiny allocs but maybe prefetching/kv sizing changed.

zoe: right — int8 reduced weight size but our prefetcher batch did bigger chunking. config used: 
```
model: maelstrom9b
quant: int8
batch_size: 6
max_new_tokens: 1500
prefetch_workers: 4
kv_target_window: 2048
alloc_policy: binpack_mixed
```

maria: logs snippet:
```
[01:26:12] kv_cache: reserve grow 800M -> 2.5G
[01:26:12] cudaError: out of memory while allocating 2048 bytes
[01:26:12] runtime: batch=6, active_prefetchers=4, gen_length=1398
```

raj: hypothesis: large max_new_tokens with batch 6 triggers heavy KV growth per request; combined with prefetch_workers leads to interleaved allocs and frees. small increments cause GPU heap fragmentation -> sporadic OOMs and long-tail p95s.

patrick: quick mitigation ideas:
- drop batch to 3 for int8 canary
- lower prefetch_workers to 1
- add post-sample kv_trim if generated_tokens > 512
- add alloc-churn microbenchmark to onboard smoke

zoe: dropping batch worked in a quick local repro. b=3 + prefetch_workers=1 -> no OOMs, p95 stable. but throughput loss obvious.

ci-bot: Canary job queued: https://ci.internal/redwood/6350012345 - matrix: b in [3,6], prefetchers [1,4], max_new_tokens [512,1500].

devops-bot: note: nodes with older CUDA driver reported slightly higher frag ratio in previous incidents. recommend checking driver versions on canary fleet.

maria: ran the quality eval (500 prompts): int8 vs fp16 showed equivalent BLEU/ROUGE for <=512 tokens. beyond 1k tokens slight drift in entity consistency for int8. will flag for product.

zoe: live canary update: 8 trials done. b=6,max_new=1500,prefetch=4 -> 2/8 OOMs, p95 ~380ms/token. b=3,max_new=1500,prefetch=1 -> 0/8 OOMs, p95 ~160ms/token.

patrick: action items I'm putting in a short runbook:
1) set maelstrom9b-int8-canary profile: batch=3, prefetch=1, max_new_tokens=512 (default)
2) add kv_trim after each sample >512 tokens
3) add alloc-churn microbenchmark to onboarding harness and fail canary if small-alloc-rate > threshold
4) fallback-to-fp16 on OOM and capture generation diff snapshot

zoe: patch applied for 1+2 to canary fleet. kicking CI.

ci-bot: Canary matrix finished: 16 trials. summary posted to artifacts.

maria: results: all b=3 trials clean. b=6 trials had 25% failure rate when prefetchers=4. we've adopted the profile and opened INF-3499 to track microbenchmark implementation + driver-check.

raj: long-term note: look into pooling/reusing small allocs (CUDA memory arenas) or using a custom slab allocator for KV buffers to reduce fragmentation across prefetchers.

zoe: agreed. putting a spike on my board to prototype arena allocator for KV.

patrick: ping me when INF-3499 is created, i'll add the microbenchmark thresholds.

zoe: closing for now, will attach logs and perf tables to ticket. :thumbsup:
